name: Moyooshi Productions
description: Moyooshi Productions is a WordPress theme for corporate event production companies: a full-bleed documentary photograph with a docked bar of hairline-outlined run-of-show cue cells, giant section words on a rule with a square arrow tab, an offset problem column, ledger rows for the method and the day of the show, a lit-truss parallax band, a mixed-width portrait triptych and one way to send a brief. Schibsted Grotesk and Karla on white and ink with a single teal accent.

fonts.role: display: headings, giant section words, numerals and the wordmark (variable 400-900, Latin subset)
fonts.copyright: Copyright 2022 The Schibsted Grotesk Project Authors

fonts.role: text: body copy, rows, navigation and captions (variable 200-800, Latin subset)

summary.en: An events theme for a corporate event production agency: a full-bleed photograph with outlined cue cells, giant section words, ledger rows and a lit-truss parallax band.
